name: skill-x
description: Single source of truth for skill-x lifecycle hooks. Generated outputs per agent live under .claude-plugin/, agents/, and .github/workflows/. Regenerate with `npm run gen-hooks`.

hooks.description: When the user edits package.json, check whether any tracked skill's npm-sourced dependency drifted.
On session start, surface any derived skill whose parent has been re-synced more recently.
